description: This file contains the implementation of the 'MessageCenter' class in the Orleans.Runtime.Messaging namespace. The class manages message sending, receiving, routing, and rejection within the Orleans distributed runtime, handling communication between silos and activation objects.

classes.name: MessageCenter
classes.description: Handles messaging operations including sending, receiving, routing, blocking, and rejecting messages within the Orleans silo runtime. Manages message proxies, connections, and tracing for diagnostics.

methods.name: SetHostedClient
methods.description: Sets the hosted client for message delivery proxy.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a message directly to a client proxy or gateway if applicable.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the message center, blocking application messages and stopping client message acceptance.

methods.name: BlockApplicationMessages
methods.description: Blocks outbound application messages, used during shutdown.

methods.name: StopAcceptingClientMessages
methods.description: Stops accepting new client messages and shuts down gateways.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Enqueues or sends a message, with logic for local, proxy, or remote delivery, including error handling and message tracing.

methods.name: DispatchLocalMessage
methods.description: Receives a message directly for local processing.

methods.name: RejectMessage
methods.description: Rejects a message with specified reason and logs the event.

methods.name: ProcessRequestsToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Handles batch of messages targeting an invalid activation, either rejecting or forwarding them based on policy.

methods.name: ProcessRequestToInvalidActivation
methods.description: Handles a single message targeting an invalid activation, with cache invalidation and forwarding or rejection.

methods.name: TryForwardRequest
methods.description: Attempts to forward a message to another silo or reject if forwarding fails.

methods.name: TryForwardMessage
methods.description: Checks if forwarding is allowed and performs message forwarding, incrementing forward count.

methods.name: ResendMessageImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual message resend, including system target handling and address updates.

methods.name: MayForward
methods.description: Determines if message forwarding is within allowed max forward count.

methods.name: AddressAndSendMessage
methods.description: Handles message addressing asynchronously before sending.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Creates and sends a response message corresponding to a request.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming message: routing to proxies, activations, or rejection on failure.

methods.name: ProcessMessageToNonExistentActivation
methods.description: Processes messages directed to non-existent activation, possibly rejecting or trying to create.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection message back to sender, avoiding rejection loops.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Implements IAsyncDisposable to stop message processing asynchronously.
